business_scope.primary_industry_name: Product Interface Design and Digital Design Subscription Agency

stage_1.document_name: Certified true copy of the natural-person Identificational Document (International Passport) of each ultimate beneficial owner, director and shareholder
stage_1.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the UBO's country of nationality; notarised by a local notary public
stage_1.authentication_path: Hague Apostille certificate issued by the competent authority of the UBO's origin country (if HCCH 1961 member) OR consular legalisation by the nearest British consulate/Gibraltar-notarised attested copy if apostille unavailable

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 2014 (Gibraltar), ss. 1-24 (formation), ss. 45-47 (name), ss. 95-96 (registered office), ss. 117-120 (officers); Companies (Exempted Companies) Regulations 2019 as applied to the Bermuda Exempted Company template; Income Tax (Exempt Companies) Rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies House Gibraltar, Registrar of Companies, Harbour Walk, Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form CR-001 Application to Register an Exempt Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the company must issue and allot one subscriber ordinary share of £0.01. Where stated capital exceeds £10,000, the excess must be fully paid and held in escrow in a licensed Gibraltar bank until the Registrar receives a Certificate of Paid-Up Capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the shareholders adopt the Memorandum and Articles of Association tendered to the meeting, and that all subscribers' share applications be accepted and allotted in accordance therewith. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be established at 12 Main Street, Gibraltar, and that the directors arrange publication and filing of the statutory notice. RESOLVED, that the subscribers nominate and do hereby elect Maria Santos and James Liu as the first directors and Anna Silva as company secretary, each to hold office until the first annual general meeting. RESOLVED, that the directors and secretary be jointly authorised to execute all incorporation filings, obtain tax identification and exchange control approvals, and open the company's primary bank account.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry via e-Registry online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form NC/01 through the Gibraltar Companies House e-Registry portal with up to three proposed company names. The Registrar checks against existing trade marks, business registers and prohibited terms under Companies Act s.45-47. Pay GBP 10 search fee online. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Identity for ultimate beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, the Registrar issues a written refusal notice with grounds. The applicant may resubmit with amended names within 14 days, or file a formal appeal under the Companies (Appeals) Rules to the Supreme Court of Gibraltar within 21 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Corporate Services Provider / Notary Public, Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The corporate service provider drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the form required for an exempted company under Gibraltar law and the Bermuda Exempted Company template. The initial subscriber signs the M&A and all consent-to-act forms. Apostille and notarisation are arranged only if the documents will be used outside Gibraltar or before foreign banks.
required_dossiers: Subscriber passport and proof of residential address
Consents of first directors and secretary
Registered office lease or letter of consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the M&A contain a defect or inconsistency, the service provider corrects and re-executes the documents within 3 business days. Where a subscriber disputes wording, the matter is resolved by written instruction from the intended beneficial owner; no judicial process is required for pre-filing amendments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies House Gibraltar, Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form CR-001 'Application to Register an Exempt Company' together with the authenticated M&A, declaration of compliance, registered office consent, and officer consents. Pay the official registration fee of GBP 150 (or USD equivalent 190) via bank transfer or card. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation electronically within one business day after approval.
required_dossiers: First directors and secretary consent forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query, the applicant has 21 days to provide supplementary documentation or correct errors. If the application is rejected, the applicant may appeal to the Supreme Court of Gibraltar under Companies Act s.330. A late response can be cured by paying a GBP 50 further processing fee and resubmitting within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Governance Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Office of the Company / Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting at the registered office. The directors pass the pro-forma first board resolution covering share subscription allotment, adoption of the registered office, and appointment of officers. Minutes are signed by the meeting chair and filed in the company's registered files. This resolution also confirms the exempt company status and authorises ongoing compliance filings.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director objects to the resolution, the matter is tabled for an emergency shareholder meeting under the M&A default provisions. A special resolution may remove or replace a director, subject to compliance with Companies Act s.107 and s.108. Legal representation can be obtained from a Gibraltar-licensed counsel at a standard cost of GBP 200 per hour.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance and Regulatory Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Revenue Department (Income Tax Office) and Gibraltar Social Insurance Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of incorporation, deliver Form GIP-102 to obtain a Tax Reference Number (TRN) and register for employer and company tax. Register employees with the Social Insurance Office. Submit a declaration of no substantial Gibraltar-source income to preserve the exempt company status. For subscription billing via Stripe and Wise, opening a corporate bank account or EMI account may be initiated under the board's authorisation.
required_dossiers: Passports of directors and ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax filing is queried due to evidence of potential Gibraltar-source trade, the company may file additional written submissions under Income Tax Act s.88. If the TRN is not issued within 45 days, the company may submit a formal complaint to the Revenue Appeals Tribunal. Late filing penalties may be cured by payment of the GBP 50 fine and submission of a complete declaration within 5 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gibraltar Business Development, Innovation and Trade Office
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None — office-based digital interface design and subscription agency is exempt from any operating permit under Schedule 2, Business Licensing (Exemptions) Ordinance 2019

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Energy, Her Majesty's Government of Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category 6 professional, scientific and technical services fall outside Annex II of the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 2018; no EIA screening or full report required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharges or VOCs produced. Sanitary effluent must comply with Gibraltar Trade Effluent (Consent) Rules where applicable. All electronic and electrical equipment waste must be handled through a licensed WEEE facility under WEEE Regulations 2015. General waste must be collected by a licensed Gibraltar waste carrier.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The registered office must obtain a Certificate of Suitability for Use from the Gibraltar Building Control Authority after structural inspection. Fire Risk Assessment and a simple emergency plan are mandatory under the Fire Safety Act 2018; a fire certificate is issued by Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service. Occupational clearance requires a written Workplace Safety Statement under the Health and Safety at Work Act 2013, including basic first-aid provision and staff safety induction.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Her Majesty's Government of Gibraltar Income Tax Office (ITO) and Companies House Gibraltar; online portal: www.ito.gov.gi and www.companieshouse.gov.gi
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-incorporated Bermuda Exempted Company, the following procedure applies: (1) appoint a Gibraltar resident company manager or tax agent; (2) file an application for a Gibraltar Tax Identification Number (TIN) with the ITO using Form GI-TIN-NR, accompanied by certified certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing from the Bermuda Registrar of Companies; (3) register for Value Added Tax (VAT) via the GRA (Gibraltar Revenue Authority) online e-postbox using VAT Form 1 if taxable supplies above the threshold or if the entity intends to recover input tax on local purchases; (4) obtain a Gibraltar business registration certificate from Companies House Gibraltar for local trading or a certificate of non-resident status if the entity merely renders offshore services without a physical establishment; (5) after issuance, file annual returns and VAT returns electronically. No notarization or apostille is required for corporate documents if submitted via a licensed agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the Income Tax Act 2010 (Gibraltar), qualifying companies may elect to be taxed under the 'qualifying company' regime. The Bermudian Exempted Company may also elect to be treated as non-resident for Gibraltar tax purposes on foreign-source income, subject to hybrid mismatch rules under OECD BEPS (Section 3 Income Tax Act 2010). There is no analogous 'check-the-box' election; however, the entity may apply for an advanced tax ruling from the ITO to confirm pass-through treatment of offshore subscription revenue.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: GBP 85,000 annual taxable turnover for goods and services supplied in Gibraltar; non-resident suppliers of digital design subscription services are required to register if they exceed this threshold through B2C supplies to Gibraltar consumers, but B2B cross-border supplies are generally zero-rated and may be exempt from local VAT registration if the place of supply is outside Gibraltar.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Gibraltar does not operate a real-time e-invoicing or fiscal clearance system. VAT returns must be submitted electronically via the GRA e-postbox portal. Electronic invoices are permitted and must be retained digitally for six years. There is no digital stamping, SAF-T, or mandatory clearance API; however, the GRA may require access to transactional data upon audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (1) goods physically exported from Gibraltar to a non-Gibraltar destination; (2) services supplied to a business customer located outside Gibraltar where the place of supply is outside Gibraltar; (3) UI/UX digital design subscription services supplied on an offshore basis to non-Gibraltar clients, provided the recipient is outside Gibraltar and the contract and invoices evidence the offshore nature. For B2C digital services, proof of customer residence outside Gibraltar is required to avoid reverse charge assessment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document / SAD)
Bill of Lading, Sea Waybill or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank receipt evidencing foreign currency receipt
Contract and invoice evidencing offshore UI/UX design subscription services
Non-residence certificate of the overseas customer for B2C supplies
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Gibraltar Revenue Authority may audit any zero-rated export claim within 6 years. Penalties for deliberate or negligent overstatement of zero-rated exports include a fine of up to 200% of the tax that would have been chargeable, interest applied retrospectively, and clawback of any input VAT recovered. Criminal prosecution may apply for fraudulent documentation, with custodial sentences possible. Amounts wrongly zero-rated are assessed as output tax with late-payment penalties and interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of England (United Kingdom) as ultimate monetary authority for the sterling-pegged Gibraltar pound; Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as the operating foreign exchange and banking regulator.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Current account and capital account transactions are fully convertible. The Gibraltar pound is pegged at parity to GBP, with free convertibility into GBP, USD, EUR and other major currencies. There are no exchange control restrictions, advance approval requirements, or profit remittance barriers for a Bermuda exempted company. Funds must merely satisfy AML/KYC and beneficial-ownership verification procedures.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender rules or mandatory conversion ratios apply to export receipts in Gibraltar. There is no prescribed timeline for converting foreign-currency trade proceeds into local currency; companies may retain or reinvest proceeds in foreign currency as treasury policy permits. Record-keeping must comply with the Proceeds of Crime Act and Gibraltar tax regulations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for using regulated electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise and Revolut, and for Stripe Billing to support the subscription model. Legal constraints: the EMI must be authorised in an appropriate jurisdiction (FCA UK or GFSC Gibraltar) and must hold safeguarding accounts at a credit institution. Many EMIs require evidence of a genuine operational link to Gibraltar/UK rather than a pure Bermuda offshore shell; an administered office, professional directorship, and demonstrable substance are therefore critical. Overall viability: High subject to substance and AML/KYC acceptance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Gibraltar banks generally require at least one director or authorised signatory to attend an in-person interview at the bank's premises. Some institutions permit remote onboarding via video conference with electronic ID verification. A Bermuda exempted company must supply certified Certificate of Good Standing, register of directors, and beneficial ownership declaration; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence will also be required for each material shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore Bermuda exempted company presenting as a potential shell such as Minimal substance or tax avoidance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, registers of directors and shareholders, current certificate of good standing from Bermuda, a Gibraltar tax/residence status letter confirming physical substance, and a Bermuda Economic Substance Act filing statement indicating actual business activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue from digital design subscriptions may be reclassified as royalties, passive income, or a flow-through treasury arrangement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed client design subscription agreements, platform terms of use, Stripe Billing transaction logs, a revenue recognition policy, and an independent professional tax opinion characterising the income as active trading profit from the provision of design/UI/UX services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Heavy reliance on EMIs and digital payment platforms instead of traditional top-tier banking may increase money-laundering and source-of-funds risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The EMI's regulatory licence details, safeguarding account confirmation from the held-at credit institution, the company's transaction ledgers showing clear economic purpose for each flow, and board resolutions authorising all treasury and banking relationships.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route via SWIFT MT103 from the beneficial owner's bank account in country of residence. The remitter instruction must state the economic purpose as equity contribution / working capital injection and include an ISO 20022 purpose code suitable for equity (e.g., 'EQUI') or otherwise provide clear business purpose detail in SWIFT Field 70. The receiving bank will verify corporate capacity by obtaining a board resolution and Bermuda share-issue or capital-contribution record. Centralise all initial funding through a single Gibraltar clearing bank to simplify compliance and audit trail.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for GBP, EUR, and USD disbursements to contractors, licensors, and SaaS platforms; use Wise or Stripe Billing for low-value recurring subscription payouts that fall below the counterparty threshold. Commercial letters of credit are not necessary or generally available for service-based digital subscriptions; the primary clearing rail is direct bank credit via SWIFT with a confirmed value date. All payee names and bank identifiers must match AML/CFT screening output before release.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla foreign exchange forward contracts with a licensed Gibraltar or UK bank
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies with limited market convertibility, when hedging contractual design vendor receipts
Cross-currency forward contracts and cross-currency swaps for larger revenue streams in EUR/USD
FX call/put options for limited premium outlay and downside protection on material invoice values

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% in Bermuda (Bermuda Exempted Company; no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax under Bermuda domestic law). If the entity is managed and controlled in Gibraltar so as to become Gibraltar tax resident, the Gibraltar flat corporate income tax rate is 12.5% on worldwide profits.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Bermuda: Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act guarantee that no new Bermuda income or capital taxation will apply before 2035; no VAT; no dividend withholding tax; annual government fee is the only recurring levy. Gibraltar: flat 12.5% corporate rate; no capital gains tax; no withholding tax on dividends, interest, or royalties; non-residents are taxed only on Gibraltar-source income; foreign tax credits are available to residents. A substance-compliant structure managed in Gibraltar carries a 12.5% effective rate; a structure with full management, staff, premises, and core income-generating activities in Bermuda can sustain a 0% Bermuda effective rate while satisfying Bermuda Economic Substance Regulations.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite under Gibraltar tax law for trading losses (no statutory time cap); in Bermuda the concept does not apply because no corporate income tax is imposed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Form AIP01 (Annual Income Tax Return for Companies), filed electronically through the Gibraltar Income Tax Office self-assessment e-portal, accompanied by audited financial statements, tax computation, and supporting transfer-pricing documentation where applicable.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a company with a 31 December accounting period, the return must be filed by 31 January in the immediately following calendar year; other accounting periods are filed by reference to the corresponding year of assessment. The Commissioner of Income Tax may grant an extension on application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification: registered name, company number, Gibraltar registered office, tax reference number, and designated representative details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies are outside the AIP01 net unless they carry on a trade through a Gibraltar permanent establishment or derive Gibraltar-source income; if filing, attach evidence of foreign tax residence and the Gibraltar PE registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Basis period: opening and closing dates of the accounting period for which chargeable income is computed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the actual accounting period end; a non-resident with a Gibraltar PE must align the basis period to the PE books.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income or turnover from the UI/UX design subscription business, including subscription fees collected via Stripe Billing and Wise, bespoke design project fees, and licensing of interface assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Resident companies declare worldwide income; non-resident companies declare only Gibraltar-source income attributable to the PE. All electronic payment processing records must reconcile to the declared turnover.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable expenses: staff costs, cloud infrastructure, software subscriptions, subcontracted design labour, legal, accounting, and marketing expenditure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses incurred wholly and exclusively for the taxable activity and backed by contemporaneous records are deductible; related-party charges must satisfy the arm's length standard.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted taxable profit or loss before capital allowances and loss relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute in accordance with the Income Tax Act 2010; non-residents must apportion profit using arm's length transfer-pricing principles.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Capital allowances claimed on plant, machinery, computer equipment, and software.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only if the qualifying asset is used for the Gibraltar trade or by the Gibraltar PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Trading losses brought forward and set off against current-year profits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may be carried forward indefinitely against profits of the same trade; continuity of ownership and trade conditions must be met.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable income after loss relief, exempt amounts, and reliefs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only Gibraltar-source chargeable income; a tax residence certificate from Bermuda is not itself sufficient to exempt Gibraltar-source trading income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation at the flat 12.5% corporate rate, reduced by foreign tax credits and double taxation arrangement relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the Gibraltar Tax Residence Certificate, any UK-Gibraltar DTA claim form, and foreign tax credit computations; document the beneficial owner for treaty claims.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable after payments on account, declaration of accuracy, and electronic payment confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must reach the Collector before the statutory deadline; provide overseas bank details for refunds, and note that late payment triggers statutory interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Gibraltar: late filing incurs a fixed penalty of GIP 100 plus GIP 100 for each additional complete month of default, subject to statutory caps; late payment attracts interest at the prescribed statutory rate (currently 1% per month or part thereof); negligent or deliberate under-declaration can trigger penalties up to 100% of the under-assessed tax and criminal prosecution. Bermuda: late Annual Return filings attract default penalties and possible strike-off; late or false Economic Substance Declarations attract civil fines and heightened regulatory scrutiny.
